## Usage

Here we find the first file that exists on disk, in array order.

```js
<<<<<<< HEAD
import {locatePath} from 'locate-path';
=======
const locatePath = require('locate-path');
>>>>>>> final-branch

const files = [
	'unicorn.png',
	'rainbow.png', // Only this one actually exists on disk
	'pony.png'
];

<<<<<<< HEAD

//=> 'rainbow'
```
